notes.title: ❄️❄️Patch #1.1❄️❄️
notes.notes:
Hello Snow Plowers!❄️❄️❄️
[b]Thank you very much for your interest and for so many downloads of the first patch![/b]

You really motivated me to work! ːsteamhappyː
In order not to disappoint you, I have prepared[b]a small fix[/b]in which you can finally[b] mute those unloved vehicle sounds![/b] I promise that [b]in the full game they will be refined to 1000%, [/b] but for now... just turn it down :) 🔕

I also moved it to the main menu and separated the ability to disable popups from the game mode[b]. [/b]Now, no matter what form of game you choose, whether you want [b]extreme hard work,[/b] 💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻 or just [b] for fun[/b] 🥳🥳🥳 you can do it regardless during the game [b]turn popups on and off![/b] I know some people will like it... ːsteamhappyː

[b]I also developed a new method of exiting vehicles, everything should now work as it should.
Remember that if you can't get out of the vehicle or get lost somewhere, you can always call roadside assistance or look at the map [key "J"].[/b] Both of these options will take you to the nearest road!

Once again, thank you very much for your comments, suggestions and help! ❄️❄️❄️
Together we will make a really [b]GREAT game![/b] 💪🏻

Arthur
[i]Snow Plowing Simulator Lead Programmer[/i]

notes.title: ❄️First Snow Patch #01❄️
notes.notes:
Hello, Everyone! ❄️❄️❄️
[b]I'm very happy that you are with me and helping me find problems and errors!
[/b]
As I promised, I am trying to[b] listen carefully to your voices[/b] and I have just [b]prepared and uploaded the first patch for Snow Plowing Simulator: First Snow![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/9c67bdcaf6f9bdcdaddb46aebc63aec3ca250b54.png[/img][u][b]You will find in it:[/b][/u][list]
[*] you noticed that you want to chill and not worry about health and calories! Therefore, now when you launch a new game, [b]you can choose the option to disable this function! Have fun![/b] 🫶🏻
[*] many people were also annoyed by the constant pop-ups with information on what to do! I understand you well, I prefer to discover the game step by step instead of clicking on what the help tells me. The function of[b] disabling popups has just appeared for you.[/b] They are generated all the time, but they do not clutter the entertainment itself and go straight to the information (I). You can always access them by clicking the "I" button!
[*] some players also experienced problems with saving and reading the game. I analyzed everything and thanks to those who reported this error,[b] it was corrected![/b] Now all game settings are saved safely.
[*] you also reported that the snow height on some properties is too high and that sometimes the snow is too close to the scenography elements - [b]I have also corrected this.[/b][/list]
[b]That's all that appeared in the first patch! I'm still working on further corrections, but I treated the above ones as the most important![/b]

Next I will work on:
❄️improving the operation of the tractor plow, especially its snow collection
❄️getting out of vehicles because, as you say, it can be a source of problems
❄️improving the wheels on the pickup truck
❄️further work on optimization
❄️vehicle physics
❄️preparing tutorials on Steam that will guide you step by step on how to play

As soon as I deal with these first childhood mistakes :), [b]I will immediately write to you what will appear in the game compared to the prologue - because remember that the prologue does not show you everything!
[/b]
If you are satisfied with the game or this patch solves your problems - please let me know, maybe recommend the game to your friends, and maybe change your comment if you have changed your mind.

[b][u]Just a note for people reporting performance problems:[/u][/b]
I understand you very well and I sympathize that Snow Plowing Simulator does not work well enough on your computer. Unfortunately, snow mechanics, calculating snow-cleared surfaces, dynamic weather, etc. [b]require adequate computing power from the computer.[/b] Especially when it comes to the [b]graphics card.[/b] If your graphics are [b]weaker than suggested,[/b] try setting the settings to minimum and disabling other programs running in the background. If this doesn't help - I'm very sorry and I'm sorry about this. [b]But don't judge the game then - just write on the forum that the game simply didn't run on your device, and by leaving negative comments you are discouraging players who could enjoy playing Snow Plowing Simulator on their own device![/b]

Thank you for your help, time and feedback!
[b]Arthur,[/b]
[i]the Main Developer of Snow Plowing Simulator[/i]

notes.title: ⚠️Working on an update⚠️
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[h3]I'm Artur, a developer💻 of the ❄️Snow Plowing Simulator - First Snow❄️ and a main game. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/4c915c094893c972919e50f3e4c1b0d617be5556.jpg[/img]

💪Firstly [b]I want to thank everyone[/b] for taking the time to check my beloved game. I appreciate it.

😢Secondly, [b]I want to apologize[/b] for all the problems you are getting. Bugs, crashes, etc🐞. Well, it's a prologue but I know it should be better... and I am working day and night now to make it so you will have joy and relax while plowing the snow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778142/1700c0b01ad11a126b87d1c5d63323cd13898237.png[/img]


[b][u]Now let's move to the main point of this announcement[/u][/b]❗️
[h3][b]Work on the patch is in progress! Tomorrow in the middle of the day the first patch should be available![/b][/h3]

[b]You will find:[/b]
[olist]
[*] ✅ Added option to disable sickness and drop calories for those who want to chill
[*] ✅ Added option to disable popups because some players have been taking them badly! Now you can choose whether you want to see them or immediately have them hide and be available under the information keys
[/olist]

😍Thanks to you we found out that the game mode in the settings is badly saved. we are just finishing fixing it.


[h3][b]Immediately everything goes to test if everything works and you will get a patch tomorrow![/b][/h3]


I've wanted just to ask you all to give me a leap of faith and I WILL DELIVER! If you have a bug/crash/glitch please write to me on 
➡️ Steam 
➡️ [url=https://discord.gg/YBVMXVCEAN]Discord[/url] https://discord.gg/YBVMXVCEAN or 
➡️ email me at arturhalaczkiewicz@gmail.com 
(the fastest would be discord). 

I really can't help if I do not know what was the problem.


All the best
Your dev.
